fields.description: Label used for the person responsible for the shift till. Set to ‘Salesperson’ if your stations use that term.
fields.label: Accountable Person Label

fields.description: Record the electronic cash register (Elec Cash) reading on every nozzle row.
fields.label: Record Elec Cash

fields.description: Record the electronic volume meter (Elec Meter) reading on every nozzle row.
fields.label: Record Elec Meter

fields.description: Record the mechanical (odometer-style) volume meter (Man Meter) reading on every nozzle row.
fields.label: Record Man Meter

fields.description: The meter value used to calculate litres sold. ‘Highest’ compares Elec Cash and Elec Meter and uses the larger value.
fields.label: Sales Basis
fields.options:
Elec Cash
Elec Meter
Man Meter
Highest

fields.description: How tank stock is measured at shift close. ‘Depth via calibration chart’ converts a dip-stick reading; ‘Litres entered directly’ skips the chart.
fields.label: Dip Entry Mode
fields.options:
Depth via calibration chart
Litres entered directly

fields.description: Maximum allowable drift between Elec Cash and Elec Meter as a percentage of sales. Drift beyond this threshold requires a reason.
fields.label: Drift Tolerance (%)

fields.description: Maximum allowable drift in litres (absolute). Both tolerances are checked; the one that allows the larger absolute drift wins.
fields.label: Drift Tolerance (L)

fields.description: If ticked, shifts with meter drift beyond tolerance cannot close without a reason text.
fields.label: Drift Beyond Tolerance Requires Reason

fields.description: 'Latest price with segments' splits a shift at each price change. 'Between shifts only' uses one price per shift.
fields.label: Price Change Mode
fields.options:
Latest price with segments
Between shifts only

fields.description: Allow price segment boundaries to be estimated by time when exact meter readings are unavailable. See design guide 6.5a.
fields.label: Allow Estimated Segments

fields.description: Shifts with more than this many payment rows are closed in a background job rather than in the web request.
fields.label: Background Close Threshold (payment rows)

fields.description: How many calendar days in the past a new shift may be opened. Set to 0 to allow today only.
fields.label: Allow Backdated Shift (days)

fields.description: If ticked, each nozzle row requires an uploaded photo of the meter display before the shift can close.
fields.label: Require Meter Reading Photo

fields.description: If ticked, each expense line requires an uploaded receipt scan before the shift can close.
fields.label: Require Expense Receipt
